caption: The drawing shows a stylized bird perched on a flowering tree branch. The bird has a body colored with shades of brown, teal, and yellow, and its wings and head are teal with a yellow patch near the neck. The bird’s long, ornate tail is split into two sections: the left section is filled with a pink color and decorated with small yellow patterns, while the right section is teal with a fine black line pattern resembling feather details. The tree is brown with green leaves and has several round, pink fruit or flowers, each with green sepals and stems, distributed across the branches. The ground beneath the tree is shown as a solid green shape. The scene is bordered by a faint, hand-drawn dotted outline forming a rectangle, and within this rectangle, faint pencil guidelines and partial motifs are visible. At the top of the drawing, above the bird, cursive text reads “Mrs. Wm. Thompson, Natla, GA.” The background is plain and the overall drawing is composed primarily of green, pink, brown, yellow, and teal colors.
title: Applique Quilt
